rca:flags.text: Reference .cnv was processed with datcnv only; alignctd / celltm / loopedit are not applied.

The .cnv holds the downcast only (27530 scans, 11436 kept after removing ship-heave reversals). Bottle (.btl) averages are taken at upcast bottle closures, so CTD-vs-Autosal uses upcast data while profiler-vs-CTD uses the downcast.
Autosal workbook header date is 2022-10-25 but the cast is on 2022-09-15; looks like a template leftover (not changed).
